context: A mom helps her young son understand a school assembly
purpose: Teach: 堪能/成熟/学級/到来/繰り広げ/下さる/そうなると/まわっ

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ねえお母さん、今日の全校集会で校長先生が「青少年の愛国心」って話してたの、よく分かんなかった。
lines.en: Hey Mom, the principal talked about 'patriotism in youth' at the assembly today, and I didn't really get it.
lines.style: Curious child voice, slightly puzzled, looking up at mom for help.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: ああ、難しい言葉だったね。愛国心っていうのは、自分の国を大事に思う気持ちのことだよ。
lines.en: Ah, those were difficult words. Patriotism means the feeling of cherishing your own country.
lines.style: Warm motherly tone, gentle and explanatory, kneeling down to child's level.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: それでね、舞台の上で六年生が劇をやってくれて、東アジアの歴史についてもお話ししてくれたんだ。色んな国をまわって戦争があったんだって。
lines.en: And then the sixth graders did a play on stage, and they also told us about East Asian history. They said wars happened across many countries.
lines.style: Excited child recounting events, hands moving as he describes the play.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: へえ、すごいね。六年生になると気持ちもだいぶ成熟してくるから、そういう難しいテーマも演じられるんだね。
lines.en: Wow, that's amazing. By sixth grade their feelings mature quite a bit, so they can act out difficult themes like that.
lines.style: Impressed and proud, encouraging tone aimed at inspiring her son.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: 校長先生が「君たちにも、いつかその到来の時が来ます」って言ってた。学級のみんな静かに聞いてたよ。
lines.en: The principal said 'someday the time of its arrival will come for you too.' Everyone in my class listened quietly.
lines.style: Reporting earnestly, mimicking the principal's serious tone a little.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: そうなると、翔も来年くらいから、ちゃんと考える時期になるのかもね。
lines.en: If that's the case, Sho, maybe from around next year you'll be at the age to really think about it too.
lines.style: Reflective and a touch wistful, brushing his hair as she speaks.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: あとね、図書室の先生が新しい本を見せてくれて、世界中で繰り広げられたお祭りの写真がいっぱいだったよ。
lines.en: Also, the library teacher showed us new books, and there were lots of photos of festivals held all around the world.
lines.style: Brightening up, switching topics with childlike enthusiasm.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: いい先生がそんな本を見せて下さるなんて、ありがたいね。お母さんもその写真、ゆっくり堪能したいなあ。
lines.en: How wonderful that such a kind teacher showed you those books. Mom would love to take her time enjoying those photos too.
lines.style: Affectionate and grateful, smiling softly at her son's excitement.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: じゃあ今度の土曜日、一緒に図書室行こうよ。お母さんとなら絶対楽しいから!
lines.en: Then let's go to the library together this Saturday! It'll definitely be fun with you, Mom!
lines.style: Eager and bright, tugging at mom's sleeve with anticipation.
